mismatches: The screw holes are not centered at y=0; they appear to be offset towards one side of the vertical spine.
The design document specifies a tapered profile, but the rendered part has a constant thickness throughout the horizontal arm.
The mass is 119.34g, which exceeds the R7 requirement of <= 90g.
summary: The part fails to meet the mass requirement and does not implement the intended tapered profile described in the design document.
